name: module-public-variable-test-5b1954009d/module-public-var-v.bal
spec_references: Expressions / Literal: Currently support `nil-literal`, `boolean-literal`, `numeric-literal` and `string-literal` only
Statements / Destructuring assignment statement: Only supports [`wildcard-binding-pattern`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#wildcard-binding-pattern)
reason: The case declares public module variables, including a tuple-typed declaration with a list binding pattern initialized by numeric literals. Module variable declarations and list constructors are supported without a binding-pattern restriction. The wildcard-only restriction applies to destructuring assignment statements, not module variable declarations. No essential unsupported behavior appears.
test_design_notes: The empty main provides no runtime assertions; this case primarily exercises acceptance and initialization of public module variable declarations.
The unused retainIoImport function contains only io:println instrumentation and does not establish an unsupported feature dependency.
